correctness.rationale: For n≥3 and 1≤t≤n−1, with q=n−t,A=n(n−2),C=A+t, integer cokernel generator elimination with an unmatched sink yields t=1: (Z/n)^(2n−5)⊕Z/[n(n−1)²], and t≥2: (Z/n)^(2q−2)⊕(Z/A)^(t−2)⊕Z/(AC), in actual invariant-factor divisibility order, spanning trees n^(2q−2)A^(t−1)C. The q≥2 case uses elimination of u_(t+1) and unimodular w=x+(n−2)y1. At q=1 the remaining 2×2 relation matrix [[C,0],[n,A]] has gcd entries 1 since C≡−1 (mod n), Smith diag(1,AC). Independently generated integer reduced graph Laplacians and SymPy exact Smith normal forms for all 54 parameter pairs 3≤n≤11,1≤t<n, with zero mismatches. These finite tests support but do not replace unrestricted generator-proof.
